exam_name.value: Medical Council of Canada Qualifying Examination (MCCQE)

purpose.value: National qualifying examination assessing critical medical knowledge and clinical decision-making at the level expected of a medical student completing their medical degree in Canada

licensure_status.value: Passing the MCCQE is one of the eligibility criteria for the Licentiate of the Medical Council of Canada (LMCC); it does NOT confer a Canadian medical licence on its own

delivery_format.locations: Canada and over 70 countries at Prometric test centres

section_structure.optional_break_note: Candidates are allowed up to 45 minutes break between sections

pilot_items.note: MCC explicitly does not identify pilot items to candidates. Distribution between sections not confirmed from current post-2025 official specification.

assessment_framework.objectives_organized_by: CanMEDS roles (Canadian Medical Education Directives for Specialists framework, modified for MCC purposes)
assessment_framework.source_title: MCC Examination Objectives | Medical Council of Canada

blueprint_categories.category_1: Dimensions of Care (spectrum of medical care)
blueprint_categories.category_2: Physician Activities (physician's scope of practice and behaviours)
blueprint_categories.note: Each category has four domains with specific content weightings on exam

data_integrity_notes: All fields contain provenance from official MCC sources accessed 2026-08-24
